subject.title: fix(gateway): force exit on zombie shutdown + 503 healthz during shutdown

question: Should this Gateway availability fix ship with forced process exit after clean shutdown, strict internal /healthz?strict=1 recovery probes, and the OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_POST_SHUTDOWN_EXIT_TIMEOUT_MS timeout override?
rationale: The code path looks coherent, but it intentionally changes process shutdown and operator configuration behavior that repository policy treats as compatibility- and availability-sensitive.

options.title: Accept recovery contract
options.body: Land the rebased PR after required CI and focused validation if Gateway owners accept forced exit, strict supervised probing, and the timeout env surface.

options.title: Remove env surface
options.body: Keep the watchdog behavior but make the timeout internal if maintainers do not want another operator-facing environment option.

options.title: Require deployed restart proof
options.body: Pause merge until the branch is deployed in a real supervised Gateway restart/shutdown scenario.

recommendation.title: Accept recovery contract
recommendation.body: Land the rebased PR after required CI and focused validation if Gateway owners accept forced exit, strict supervised probing, and the timeout env surface.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the strongest history across the live-probe and supervised-recovery paths this PR changes.
